holders.description: 2.2 action adapter: robots whose recorded, non-releasing holds have current measured contact/pose validity. Legacy adapters: persistent holding records, retained through in-progress release.

grasp_sites.description: Grasp site for each holder represented in this observation.

approached_sites.description: Most recently completed approach site for each recorded robot.

destination_supported.description: Both destination stands have measured contact, placement is in bounds, and payload motion is settled.

released.description: Release has completed with separation verified.

observation.description: Complete two-robot simulator observation, returned by physical skills and refreshed by the 2.2 runtime. The trusted observation adapter supplies these facts, never the planner.

behavioral_contract_authority: Planner-facing descriptions of implemented checks, not executable predicates. The trusted primitive and recovery policy implementations enforce them; the LLM cannot redefine them.

required_measurements: robot joint position/velocity and forward-kinematic end-effector pose
localized base pose and payload pose/velocity
bilateral gripper-payload contact and supported-surface contact
observation_adapter.deployment_mapping: Replace simulator queries with calibrated perception/state estimation and contact/force sensing. Map named object sites through estimated object pose. Validate freshness, uncertainty and thresholds before hardware use.
observation_adapter.limitations: Current poses/contact identities are exact simulator observations; destination and support height come from scene configuration. Approach targets are sampled at action start. No noisy-sensor adapter or moving-target tracking is implemented.

prelift_grasp_reacquire.trigger: GRASP_LOST for a previously confirmed hold before lift
guards: both initial stands have measured loaded contact throughout repair; payload settled at repair start
affected end effector remains aligned to its named grasp site: position error < 0.025 m, orientation error < 0.2 rad, joint velocity norm < 0.35
repair: trusted recovery-only grasp adapter recloses the affected gripper in place
retain existing arm servo targets; do not repeat approach or move the unaffected robot
preserves: unaffected robot's completed actions and valid hold
prelift_grasp_reacquire.attempt_bound_semantics: At most two supported loss episodes per robot; the first failed repair or timeout aborts immediately without retrying that failed repair.
prelift_grasp_reacquire.completion: Pose stays aligned; bilateral contact persists for 0.25 s after at least 0.4 s of closure; lift requires both current grasps continuously valid for 0.15 s.
prelift_grasp_reacquire.exhaustion: Stop with explicit failure; no additional LLM call.
prelift_grasp_reacquire.unsupported: RECOVERY_POSE_INVALID for misalignment; arbitrary object displacement and airborne repair are not implemented.
